bias_targets.methodology: Dynamic human-and-model-in-the-loop adversarial data collection where annotators actively create examples to exploit heuristic shortcuts, hypothesis-only biases, and spurious correlations in state-of-the-art models across NLI, QA, and Sentiment Analysis.

Iterative adversarial data collection by trained analysts who create challenging synthetic hate speech examples, labeling the specific protected characteristic or group attacked to investigate model decision boundaries and error rates.
